text:
maria: Planning sync for NexTherm dedicated bring-up. Primary asks: quota mapping, autoscale target, canary gating, and rollback triggers. Goal: run staging dry-run tonight and prod cutover tomorrow if green.

ashley: Sales provided traffic profile: baseline 28k tokens/min, daily spikes ~60k, marketing push could hit short bursts to 140k tokens/min for ~15m. Need clear cost treatment for burst.

kevin: Customer signed off on shadowing for 45m. Hard stop conditions they asked for: p95 > 450ms OR 0.8% 5xx errors = immediate pause. I'll own customer comms.

tony: Infra recs: allocate reserved pool to cover baseline + 50% headroom (so ~42k steady capacity) and autoscale for bursts up to 160k with fast scale-up but slower scale-down (to avoid thrash). Suggest smoothing window 90s and cooldown 240s.

tony: Sample policy to test:
```
autoscale_policy:
  reserved_capacity_tokens_per_min: 42000
  max_capacity_tokens_per_min: 160000
  scale_up_window_s: 30
  smoothing_window_s: 90
  scale_down_cooldown_s: 240
```

sam_engineer: I'll run staged tests on staging cluster tonight 22:30 PT: 20m soak at baseline, then stepped bursts: 60k for 5m, 100k for 5m, 140k for 10m. Will tag runs with `nextherm:staging-dryrun-<TS>`. Vegeta + our internal traffic-replay harness.

liz_ops: Add ops checks: watch kube pod churn, redis/KV latency, and disk I/O on logging nodes. If node eviction rate > 2/min or cache miss ratio jumps > 10% signal rollback.

ashley: Finance watchers: confirm whether bursts counted as reserved usage or overage. We need answer before prod. I'll pause prod cutover if billing gate not cleared.

maria: Quality gate: run 200 eval prompts pre and post each burst stage using the NexTherm eval set (seeded). Fail if semantic regression rate > 1.5%. Post results to the run log.

sam_engineer: Load commands (staging):
```
# base payload file
cat > payload.json <<EOF
{
  "input": "<eval prompt>",
  "max_tokens": 256
}
EOF
vegeta attack -targets=payload.json -rate=200 -duration=10m | vegeta report
```

tony: Important headers for reserved routing: `X-Redwood-Tier: reserved`, `X-Customer-ID: nextherm-001`, `X-Trace-Tag: nextherm-dryrun-<TS>`. Observability will pick these up for filtering.

kevin: Renewal risk note: if we hit 2+ rollbacks or any customer-visible delay for >30m during cutover, flag account high-risk and schedule AM + CS leadership review.

liz_ops: Rollback checklist (short): 1) flip traffic to shared fallback via router api, 2) scale reserved pool down to baseline, 3) revoke burst allowances, 4) open incident and notify kevin. I'll script router flip.

maria: Who will post the final runbook? Need it in Ops Runbooks with approval gates and cost table.

ashley: I'll draft the runbook and include cost mapping table (reserved baseline, allowed burst, overage rate) and the approval matrix. Will ask finance + legal signoff for billing ambiguity.

sam_engineer: I'll post staging run id and logs after completion. Expect run id: staging-nx-1812349999. Logs at https://staging-logs.internal/job/staging-nx-1812349999

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: "nextherm-staging-dryrun" start=2026-03-24T22:30:00Z id=1812349999. Monitor at https://deploys.redwood.internal/jobs/1812349999

maria: Reconvene 07:45 PT tomorrow for go/no-go. Thanks all.
